answer.rationale: Primary region write path is degraded 5x at peak settlement load. Rollback is blocked by compliance on security patch. Regional failover is proven (memory_b2: clean traffic shift, minutes to recovery) and orthogonal to the release constraint. Verification of b2 confirms failover efficacy under load; b5 confirms read-path separation doesn't interfere with write recovery. This preserves all customer writes by shifting to healthy capacity in another region while the primary can be investigated without time pressure. Circuit breaker and add_capacity are defensive but don't address the localized degradation; routing reads helps but doesn't solve write path saturation under peak load.
